data.name: Image classification
data.summary: Label every image in a public or permitted batch with its top three classes.
data.input: One image per job (public or permitted)
data.checkMethod: A share of jobs is re-run by the operator on a reference device; the top label must match.

data.name: Semantic search
data.summary: Embed a batch of images so it can be searched with plain-language queries.
data.input: One image per job, plus your text queries
data.output: Image embedding, ranked against each query
data.checkMethod: A share of embeddings is recomputed by the operator; similarity must agree within a tolerance.

data.name: More job types
data.summary: Added when a buyer needs them and they can be checked.
data.checkMethod: Each new job type ships with its own check.
